title: Doctor Visit
objective: Describe your symptoms to a doctor, understand the advice and ask about medicine.
learnerRole: a patient who is not feeling well
opening: Hello, please have a seat. What seems to be the problem today?
targetSentences: I've had a sore throat for three days.
How often should I take this medicine?
mainQuest: Describe your symptoms to a doctor, mention an allergy, and ask how to take the medicine.

questSteps.text: Describe your main symptom and how long you have had it.
questSteps.hint: 说症状，再说持续了多久
anchors: I've had a sore throat for three days.

questSteps.text: Mention what you are allergic to.
Ask how often to take the medicine.
anchors: How often should I take this medicine?
